correctness.rationale: Smoothness follows from the five squared partial derivatives. Grothendieck–Lefschetz makes all automorphisms projective. For each positive odd m scalar cube-normalization is unique, and the normalized matrix equation forces B[4]=P^2 B P^-2, hence coefficients in F2^gcd(m,10). The binary asymmetry-centralizer has exactly five orthogonal elements P^i. The explicit invertible self-dual normal-basis matrix U over F32 transforms the cubic to the Fermat form; isometries descend to O5(F2)=Sp4(F2) of order720. The polynomial-field verifier reconstructs the matrices and independently enumerates all 720 and checks their lifted isometry equations; the finite enumeration is supplemental, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The full rational automorphism group is a fundamental invariant of the famous Klein cubic threefold. The complete odd-extension tower shows a sharp symmetry jump at the natural fifth-degree splitting field, explained by explicit Galois descent rather than isolated small-field enumeration. It also proves that the known five binary rational lines form one regular orbit under every F2 automorphism. Odd degrees are intrinsically natural here because scalar cube-normalization is canonical; no arbitrary parameter slice or unmotivated tiny computation is used.
